name: Quick Pill 5.7.1
changelog: Feature: Vision Pill Funimated Upgrade - Interactive cartoon physics and tactile spring dynamics across all modules.
Feature: Liquid Battery Hub - 3-layer parallax fluid sine waves, rising micro-bubbles, charging neon lightning, and low-battery warning tremor.
Feature: Shelf Puddle Ripple Engine - concentric puddle shockwave rings, upward parabolic splash droplets, and buoyant file cards.
Feature: Obsidian Visor-Cat Mascot with volume-preserving squash & stretch, spring cursor gaze tracking, and SVG starburst particles.
Feature: Pomodoro Cardiac Glow Ring, elastic CPU/RAM gauges with live beacon dots, tactile clipboard checkmark pop, and bouncy calendar cells.
Stability: Pure Electron runtime with zero WebView2 dependencies and 100% passing test coverage.
